name: L10 PanoLab new-city federated temporal appearance confirmation
question: Does the unchanged two-reference, reciprocal top-two-of-three appearance router transfer to two new Caen targets without emitting wrong-target candidates?
pre_call_observation_boundary: Both target rows passed human-visible same-building truth before any router call. Four anchor pixels had been reviewed in an earlier portal-source audit; all six linked-neighbour pixels and every selected image remained unseen to this router.

aggregation.references: Exactly two cross-collection entrance-ray reference windows per target.
aggregation.query_sequence: Exact reciprocal prev, anchor, next frames.
aggregation.per_frame: Unchanged strict entrance-ray crop and 0.35 CLIP + 0.25 DINOv2 + 0.40 mutual-patch-geometry score against the fixed two-reference bank.
aggregation.per_target_sequence_score: Arithmetic mean of the highest two of three per-frame target scores; deterministic ties by relation name.
aggregation.no_adaptation: No model, crop, reference count, frame count, feature weight, aggregation, threshold, target roster, target alias, or image may change after the result is observed.

accept_contract.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positive rows before the open-set, Grenoble, temporal, and Caen panels.
accept_contract.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.

required: four cross-collection reference views and six reciprocal query frames
zero target-way and item overlap with the prior router cohorts
0 wrong-target candidates across 14 counterfactual wrong-goal trials
gate.failure_policy: Preserve the first result. Do not tune or resample this panel.

research_basis.title: SeqNet: Learning Descriptors for Sequence-Based Hierarchical Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates short sequence evidence for place recognition; this replay uses a deterministic top-two reducer, not SeqNet.

research_basis.title: JIST: Joint Image and Sequence Training for Sequential Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates checking both image and sequence transfer. This replay neither trains nor attributes performance to JIST.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence for or against the unchanged temporal appearance router on exactly two new-city, target-way/item-disjoint, router-unseen Caen targets in one same-provider eight-target closed roster.
not_allowed: blind, independent, provider-disjoint, fully pixel-unseen, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment confirmation
trained sequential-descriptor performance or attribution to SeqNet or JIST
exact physical identity authority, sign-to-building association, pixel portal grounding, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
